mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as svcrProposeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as svcrProposeAbbName, svv.Svv_Project_Name as svvProjectName, svis.Svis_Project_Name as svisProjectName, svis.Svis_Name as svisName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Con_Svcr mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Svcr_Propose_Id=c1.C_Id left join Con_Sv_Verify svv on mn.Svv_Id=svv.Svv_Id left join Con_Svis svis on svis.Svis_Id=mn.Svis_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Svcr_Id where mn.Svcr_Id=#{svcrId}
